summary: The gold was built from the Sonnet candidate, whose prose, points and numbers are faithful but which omitted every printed table (blank and filled), produced six clipped or text-swallowing figure boxes and made a few silent corrections and additions; Haiku and GLM are far worse (garbled or missing solutions, wrong values such as Коларус/Колап/Силка, missing Problem 4 data, invented photo descriptions, and a false incomplete flag). Of the 27 checker findings, 20 are true positives: the GLM checker's content findings against Haiku are reliable, but both GLM figure findings against Sonnet's p4 boxes and the Haiku checker's four label findings are false, and no checker found the missing tables. No page is illegible; two source-quirk points (criterion В) „R и P“, the legend pictograms) are escalated for a human look at the PDF.
